Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly interpret the release year data from the Wikipedia page for "Gaza Ghetto". In Step 11, the Planner analyzed the Wikipedia page which stated the film was "created... in 1984" and the title included "1948 - 1984". The Planner incorrectly interpreted this production period or the film's subject matter as the release year, or simply failed to distinguish between the production year (1984) and the official release year (1985) which was already confirmed by the IMDb source in Step 9. Consequently, in the final decision (Step 11), the Planner concluded that "Gaza Ghetto was released more recently than Kull the Conqueror" by claiming the release year was 1985 but seemingly treating the 1984/1948 context as the primary identifier, leading to a logical contradiction where it claimed 1985 was more recent than 1997 while the analysis of the Wikipedia page suggested a 1984 date. The error stems from a failure to synthesize the IMDb data (1985) with the Wikipedia data (1984 production) to confirm the 1985 release date as the definitive metric for comparison, resulting in a confused final conclusion.
